content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: in both shown sessions, validation errors appear on the Ir Swap screen after the Trade Date entry (errors 52:a53 and 56:a58; 51:a56 and 56:a66), and shortly after, the user opens the Static Data menu and selects its Counterparty item, which navigates to the Counterparty screen (app:30, app:35) and returns to Ir Swap through a single tab click (9310, 137) about 3 s later, a pattern that repeats within the task.", "fix": "Fix: On the Ir Swap screen, add an inline counterparty lookup to the Counterparty input (or a link beside it that opens Counterparty in a side panel) so the Static Data menu \u203a Counterparty round trip from the header is not needed; also keep the Trade Date validation error next to the Trade Date field so it is visible without leaving the screen.", "cited_event_ids": ["52:a53", "56:a58", "51:a56", "56:a66", "107", "116", "app:30", "9310", "137", "app:32", "163", "app:35"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["Only 2 of the 3 affected sessions are in the windows; the third session's events were not provided.", "The reason for the Counterparty visit is not recorded in the events; the link to validation errors is a temporal pattern, not a confirmed cause.", "The contents of the Counterparty screen and whether it offers a lookup are not in the events.", "Whether the Trade Date error is what the user was responding to is not confirmed.", "Coverage data is empty, and dropped_pointer_samples (132 and 158) limit pointer-level detail.", "The 6.0 s median time lost is taken from the insight facts and not recalculated here."]}
